name: Configure Meta Pixel and fire commerce funnel events
description: Verifies REBORN can be connected to a Meta Pixel without code changes and emits standard events for the ad funnel.
steps: Sign in at #admin, enter a numeric Meta Pixel ID and save settings
Open a collection and view a product
Add the product to cart, start WhatsApp checkout and use Check availability
expected: The Meta Pixel initializes and queues PageView, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout and Contact events with product/category/value data where applicable.

name: Meta tracking remains disabled when Pixel ID is blank
description: Verifies the storefront still works normally before a Meta Pixel ID is supplied.
steps: Leave Meta Pixel ID blank in admin
Browse collections, view products and add to cart
expected: Shopping features work normally and no Meta Pixel script is initialized by REBORN.

name: Combo Sales ad landing remains functional
description: Verifies the dedicated campaign page remains usable with ad tracking enabled.
expected: The Combo Sales page shows its configured heading and only Combo Sale products.

name: Collection ad landing remains functional
description: Verifies collection campaign links still open directly to the relevant products.
expected: The Women landing page opens correctly and product browsing remains functional.

name: WhatsApp checkout still opens with payment instructions
description: Verifies tracking does not interfere with the existing WhatsApp purchase flow.
expected: The InitiateCheckout event is fired and WhatsApp opens with the order summary and transfer instructions.
